verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs describe automations that run without user intervention: RSS/blog emails send automatically when new content is published, and simple workflows can automate actions after an email is sent. However, the workflow engine itself (triggers, branching, agent-driven autonomy) is only mentioned in passing. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of workflow triggers and actions, evidence of agent-driven autonomous background execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: This email will be sent automatically when you publish new content to your blog or RSS feed.
You can set up simple workflows to automate actions after the email is sent.
You can send a marketing email immediately or schedule the email to send at a specific date and time.
any changes made in one system are automatically synced to the other
